Baseline reuses all pinned WORLD42 candidate runs, which followed compilation and ran serially without competing GPU work. This candidate also runs after CPU gates. No controlled hardware-clock or interactive-performance acceptance; changed material work is intentional.
CBT/AS update work remains in measured frames. Identical frame count does not establish converged topology or equal material residency.
Geometry follows the shared render-only soil, not authoritative collision. Sampled leaf corner/fold clearance is not exact continuous contact or nonintersection against final CBT triangles.

Sweep runs exercise moving camera/streaming/CBT/RT paths, but only final images and per-frame timings are recorded; no full image sequence or temporal-stability acceptance. No new GI, canopy transport, rain/hydrology, GPU passes, other-platform or remote CI validation.
Full-scene source/admission and fixed-camera metadata are checked, but asynchronous material/height residency can differ. Blind pairs are unvoted and can be invalidated by confounds.

RT record counts include padded terrain capacity, not live primary triangles or ray intersections; AS bytes are planning estimates, not measured driver VRAM.
